mascot.hero_no_instance: No instances yet. Let's create one!
mascot.hero_no_account: Hello! Add an account to get started.
mascot.hero_idle_sleep: Zzz… wake me up with the Play button
mascot.hero_online: Hi {name}! Ready to jump into the game?
mascot.after_crash: Game crashed… check the game log.
mascot.after_done: Had fun? See you again soon!

play.no_instance: You don't have any instances yet. Each instance has its own folder, mods, and RAM allocation.
play.no_account_hint: Click to add a Microsoft or Offline account
play.err_no_account: Please add an account before playing.

instances.title: Your Instances
instances.subtitle: Each instance has its own world folder, mods, and configuration.
instances.empty_desc: Create a Vanilla instance to play right away, or add Fabric / Quilt / Forge / NeoForge for mods.
instances.loader_forge_hint: Forge/NeoForge will be installed using the official installer on first run, which may take a few minutes.
instances.loader_unsupported: {loader} does not support Minecraft {mc} yet. Please choose another version.
instances.ram_total_hint: Your computer has {ram} RAM. Heavy modpacks recommend 6–8 GB.
instances.field_share_desc: Worlds, multiplayer server list, resource packs, shaders, and screenshots are shared across instances. Mods and config remain separate.
instances.edit_warning: Changing version or loader will reinstall the loader on the next launch. Worlds and mods will be kept, but old mods may not be compatible.
instances.err_select_loader: Please select a valid loader version.
instances.toast_imported: Imported “{name}”. Loader will be installed on first launch.
instances.err_stop_before_del: Please stop the game before deleting.
instances.confirm_del_text: This action cannot be undone. The instance folder will be permanently deleted (shared worlds will not be affected).
instances.err_fetch_mc: Failed to fetch Minecraft versions. Check your network connection.
instances.confirm_unshare_text: This instance will have its OWN separate worlds, servers, and resources folder. Existing shared worlds will remain in the shared folder. Do you want to copy existing shared data to this private instance? (may use substantial disk space)
instances.err_stop_before_unshare: Please exit the game before disabling shared data.

mods.title: Mods & Content
mods.subtitle: Search on Modrinth and install directly to the selected instance.
mods.warn_vanilla: This instance is Vanilla, so mods will not load. Click Edit in Instances to choose Fabric, Quilt, Forge, or NeoForge.
mods.empty_installed: No {type} installed yet. Switch to Discover tab to find some.
mods.no_results: No matching results found. Try different keywords.
mods.toast_installed_pack: Created instance “{name}”. Open it in Play to install loader and start.
mods.need_instance_desc: Mods are installed per instance. Please create a Fabric, Quilt, Forge, or NeoForge instance first.
mods.hint_modpack: Modpacks will create a new instance.
mods.hint_compat: Only showing content compatible with Minecraft {mc}{loader}.

servers.title: Local Servers
servers.subtitle: Host a Minecraft server right on your PC to play with friends on LAN.
servers.empty_desc: One click gives you a Vanilla, Fabric, or Paper server running on your computer. Launcher downloads Java and server files automatically.
servers.cmd_ph_on: Enter command, e.g.: op YourName, say hello, list
servers.field_online_mode_desc: Disable to allow offline/cracked accounts to join.
servers.field_expose_desc: Automatically creates a free tunnel so friends outside LAN can join.
servers.field_eula: I agree to the Minecraft EULA (Mojang)
servers.confirm_del_text: Select "Delete worlds and files" to remove the server folder completely. If you only remove from list, files remain on disk.
servers.toast_crashed: Server stopped unexpectedly. Check the console for details.
servers.hint_fabric: Supports Fabric mods: place mods into server mods folder.
servers.hint_paper: Fast, lightweight, supports plugins. Recommended for multiplayer.
servers.hint_purpur: Fork of Paper with extra gameplay customizations; compatible with Paper plugins.
servers.err_eula: You must agree to the Minecraft EULA to run the server.
servers.err_fetch_mc: Failed to load versions list. Check your network connection.
servers.hint_ram: 2 GB is enough for 2–5 players. More mods/plugins require more RAM.
servers.hint_view_distance: Lower = less RAM/CPU usage. 8 is recommended.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Online to join official servers, Offline for singleplayer or unauthenticated servers.
accounts.ms_desc: Use the account that purchased Minecraft Java Edition. A Microsoft login window will appear; the launcher never sees your password.
accounts.off_desc: Simply enter a player name. Offline accounts cannot join servers requiring Mojang authentication.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add an account to start playing.
accounts.confirm_del_text: Only removes from the launcher, does not affect your actual account. You can re-add anytime.
accounts.ms_fallback:
Could not fetch Minecraft profile ({reason}).
Created offline account "{name}" from your Xbox profile.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lang_desc: Choose the display language for the launcher interface.
settings.ram_default: Default RAM when creating new instances
settings.java_shared: Shared Java path (empty = auto-download proper Java for each instance)
settings.hide_on_launch_desc: Launcher restores automatically when you exit the game.
settings.free_ram_desc: Closes the launcher window while in-game (saves ~150 MB), restores when exiting. Requires the above setting.
settings.about_hint: Noob Launcher {version} · {platform}/{arch}. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Studios; this launcher is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

panel.btn_kill_title: Force stop immediately, may lose unsaved data
panel.warn_running: Server is running: some files may be overwritten when server saves, or take effect only after restart.
panel.confirm_del_desc: This cannot be undone. Make sure to back up first if unsure.
panel.confirm_kill_desc: The server stops immediately and unsaved data may be lost. Use only if frozen.
panel.no_props_file_banner: server.properties not created yet (created on first server run). Showing default values.
panel.warn_running_props: Server is running: changes take effect after restart.
panel.add_player_ph: Player name (or IP for IP ban)
panel.offline_mode_hint: Server is in offline-mode: UUID is generated from username.
panel.vanilla_no_mods_desc: Edit server and switch type to Paper/Purpur (plugins) or Fabric (mods).
panel.confirm_del_mod_desc: File will be deleted from server.
panel.backup_count_hint: {count} backups · keeping newest {keep} "auto" backups (schedule in Schedules tab)
panel.confirm_restore_desc: All current server data will be replaced by this backup. A safety backup "before-restore" will be created automatically.
panel.sched_hint: Only runs while launcher is open.
panel.empty_sched: No scheduled tasks yet. E.g.: backup daily at 04:00, restart every 6 hours.
panel.net_internet_desc: Friends can join your server without port forwarding. Requires a free Playit.gg account link.
panel.waiting_browser_auth: Waiting for your confirmation in browser…
panel.net_lan_hint: LAN address for friends on same Wi-Fi/local network.
panel.confirm_unlink_desc: Exposed servers will be disconnected from the Internet.
panel.auto_start_launcher_desc: Server starts when Noob Launcher opens.
panel.stop_srv_to_change_java: Stop server to change Java settings.
panel.playit_not_linked_error: Playit.gg not linked. Open panel → Network tab to link.
